name: Arc browser landing page by arc.net
description: The page alternates saturated colour bands — a textured cobalt for nav, press quote and closing CTA, warm peach-to-pink gradients for the hero, and cream panels for the press ticker and community quotes — all joined by signature zigzag edges. Feature sections on white follow one strict rhythm: a short cobalt rounded-sans heading with a grey subline, then a single oversized rounded product screenshot instead of feature grids. Social proof is split into a scrolling cream marquee of press quotes and a four-column wall of bold blue user quotes with handle pills, before the cobalt CTA and footer close the page on the same zigzag motif.
